copy.tagline: 设计子问题的最佳回答顺序
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为复杂问题规划子问题的回答顺序
copy.tagline_en: Design the optimal answering order for sub-questions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan the order of sub-questions for complex queries

howto.what: Claude会根据子问题间的依赖关系，设计出最佳回答顺序：哪些能并行、哪些必须串行，并给出理由和风险提示。
howto.when: 当你提供子问题列表和依赖图时触发。

say.text: 请根据依赖关系设计子问题的回答顺序。
say.note: Claude会输出分阶段执行计划。

say.text: 这些子问题中哪些可以并行回答？
say.note: Claude会识别无依赖的子问题，给出并行分组。

say.text: 请优先处理高风险子问题。
say.note: Claude会调整顺序，尽早发现不可行分支。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes dependencies between sub-questions to design the optimal answering order: which can run in parallel vs. sequential, with rationale and risk notes.
howto.when_en: When you provide a list of sub-questions and a dependency graph.

say_en.text: Please design the answering order based on dependencies.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a phased execution plan.

say_en.text: Which of these sub-questions can be answered in parallel?
say_en.note: Claude identifies independent ones and groups them.
Claude reorders to fail fast if needed.
